paragraphs: Rolling machine operators set roll gap, guides, and material feed per work orders, and monitor the rolling cycle, jams, thickness, and surface defects; on anomalies they stop the machine and respond per procedure. The O*NET occupational scope covers both metal and plastic.

Adjacent to extruding and drawing machine setters, forging machine operators, cutting and punching machine operators, and industrial machinery maintenance workers; the core output of this occupation is rolled material that meets specifications, not repairing entire equipment sets.

AI can help organize work orders, trend records, and defect classification drafts; material condition, actual dimensions, roll gap, jams, and personnel safety must still be verified on site, and the model cannot automatically approve machine adjustment or return to service.

Before applying, verify the rolling mill type, material, roll gap and thickness measurement method, equipment guarding, energy isolation, shifts, scrap handling, and machine adjustment authority; practice materials are not connected to a real rolling mill.

The BLS 51-4023 standalone occupation had a 2025 median annual wage of 50,140 U.S. dollars; 2025—2035 employment falls from 25,300 to 23,200 (a decline of 8.3%), with about 1,900 annual openings. Chinese manufacturing average wages serve only as industry background.

O*NET 51-4023.00 covers setting up, operating, or tending metal and plastic rolling machines: read rolling work orders and drawings, adjust roll gap and guides, start the machine and monitor jams and operation, measure the thickness and shape of plate, strip, or structural shapes, correct defects, and record batches.
O*NET 51-4023.00 is a standalone occupation; 2025 wages and 2025—2035 employment both follow the same BLS occupational row and do not borrow statistics from adjacent machine tool workers.

entries: Work order and material verification｜Read drawings, specifications, and material labels.｜Mark thickness, shape, surface, and batch requirements.
Equipment setup｜Set roll gap, guides, feed, and related parameters as authorized.｜Keep setup and change records.
Trial rolling and operation｜Start the rolling mill and observe material passage, cycle, and jams.｜Stop and escalate on anomalies.
Dimension inspection｜Measure thickness, width, and shape with applicable gauges.｜Record samples, instruments, and measured values.
Defect handling｜Identify misalignment, scratches, out-of-tolerance thickness, and raw material anomalies.｜Isolate product and request review.
Handover and upkeep｜Record equipment condition, batches, and unresolved risks.｜Clearing jams, repairs, and return to service follow authorized procedures.

entries.answer: Set up or operate metal and plastic rolling machines per work orders, adjust roll gap and guides, monitor jams, measure thickness, shape, and surface, and record batches and anomalies.
entries.question: What do rolling machine operators mainly do?

entries.answer: Extruding and drawing workers form material with dies, forging workers deform it with pressure, and industrial machinery maintenance workers disassemble and repair equipment; rolling machine operators focus on controlling continuous rolling and product dimensions.
entries.question: How is this different from rolling machine operators?

entries.answer: The typical BLS 51-4023 entry is a high school diploma or equivalent with moderate-term on-the-job training, not a unified threshold for all employers.
entries.question: Is a high school diploma or equivalent required to enter?

entries.answer: The BLS 2025 national median annual wage cited by O*NET is 50,140 U.S. dollars, with P10 at 37,690 and P90 at 70,310 U.S. dollars; these are not individual or regional quotes.
entries.question: How much do U.S. rolling machine operators earn?

entries.answer: This page has not yet obtained a nationwide precise occupational wage distribution for rolling machine operators in mainland China. The National Bureau of Statistics 2025 pre-tax annual average manufacturing wages are 113,594 yuan for urban non-private units and 76,055 yuan for private units; the figure for "production, manufacturing, and related personnel" at above-designated-size enterprises in that industry is 79,182 yuan. These industry and broad-job references cover different populations and are not this occupation's wages, median, or starting pay, and cannot be assembled into an income range or attributed to AI. Metal and plastic rolling machine setup, tending, thickness measurement, and quality records correspond to the manufacturing scenario; the broad production and manufacturing category cannot distinguish rolling operators, materials, or shifts. Specific quotes must verify city, duties, working hours, contract term, base pay, and allowances／commission, and pre-tax versus after-tax.

entries.answer: There is no reliable AI substitution rate for this occupation. AI can assist with work orders and anomaly summaries, while roll setup, measured dimensions, jams, and personnel safety are still verified by people.
